correctness.rationale: The full LP is exactly reduced by proving every vertex pair is an exact resolving neighborhood and exhaustively classifying singleton neighborhoods; nonnegative pair constraints then dominate every larger resolving neighborhood. The reduced programs are solved analytically, including uniqueness. The unreduced LP and coordinate ranges are independently replayed for n=2..20.

value.rationale: The relaxation is not an arbitrary new parameter: it is the direct continuous relaxation of the foundational binary optimization model. The exact unique optimizer and asymptotically factor-two integrality gap provide a natural benchmark for formulation strength and mixed-metric optimization on a standard graph family.
